name: Drake’s Crest
body:
Price 4,000 GP (Simple), 16,000 GP (Ornate); Aura moderate transmutation; CL 5th; Slot head; Weight 3 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This ornate headpiece appears to be blank at first until worn by a drake, taking on a color and theme of importance to the wearer, imbuing them with a sense of pride and devotion towards their charge. The wearer of this crest gains one drake power decided when this item is created; if a drake wears a crest which would grant them a drake power for which they do not qualify, it has no effect upon them, and drake powers gained through crest may be used as prerequisites for other drake powers provided the drake has worn the crest for 24 hours. An ornate drake crest instead bestows two drake powers. A drake which does not have a charge gains no benefit from this item.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Cost 2,000 GP (Simple), 8,000 GP (Ornate); Craft Wondrous Item; Spells form of the dragon I
